text: The Closing Rite is won. By nightfall the Common Hall has stopped pretending to be a dining room and become a roar.

speaker: Perrin
text: A TOAST! To the year, to the rite — and to the commoner who out-fought every noble in this room! I SAID WHAT I SAID.

speaker: Serra
text: For once, Perrin's volume is proportionate to the occasion. Well fought. All of you.

speaker: Rina
text: Enjoy tonight. The math says next year is... interesting.

speaker: Kai
text: One year ago I'd never left my village. Tonight a castle is cheering. Strange magic, this place.
